facts.fact: 男主把相机和胶卷留在修理店时心里涌起奇怪的不情愿，觉得它们本就属于这栋房子
facts.anchor: He left the camera and film with an odd reluctance. They belong in the house, he thought. It feels wrong to take them away.

facts.fact: 男主查 Lyke 的教堂、图书馆与墓地，关于 Arthur 和 Caroline 的线索一无所获
facts.anchor: Neither yielded anything regarding Arthur and Caroline.

facts.fact: 男主找到 Howling Man 石碑，上面粗糙地刻着像是狗群袭击人的图案
facts.anchor: including the one called the Howling Man: a saddle of stone pushing out of the ground, with a rough carving of what might have been dogs, attacking a human figure

facts.fact: Howling Man 石碑上的圆圈让男主想起网球，以及它们曾如何令他不安
facts.anchor: That made him think of the tennis balls, and how they had disturbed him

facts.fact: Lucy 告诉男主 Barguest 是死亡的预兆，专袭击孤独的旅人
facts.anchor: A great black dog – a portent of death – that preys on lonely travellers

facts.fact: Lucy 说 Howling Man 展示的是 Barguest 与它的猎物，以及 Gabble Ratchet（尸犬群）
facts.anchor: Some people think the Howling Man shows the Barguest and his prey, with the Gabble Ratchet – his pack of corpse-hounds

facts.fact: Lucy 叫男主 Arthur，说「没关系，它相信你」
facts.anchor: She shook her head, still smiling, saying over her shoulder: ‘That’s okay, Arthur. It believes in you.’

facts.fact: 结尾外面 Gabble Ratchet 嚎叫，但男主知道那只是风
facts.anchor: Outside, the Gabble Ratchet howled – though that, he knew, was just the wind.
